filter.verdict: UNCLEAR (too few changes in the base)
filter.verdict_clean: UNCLEAR (too few changes in the base)

listing.verdict: UNCLEAR (too few changes in the base)
listing.verdict_clean: UNCLEAR (too few changes in the base)

other.verdict: UNCLEAR (too few changes in the base)
other.verdict_clean: UNCLEAR (too few changes in the base)

bracket.planted: params drift: bracket width limit 0.1 sd (as if 1.5 w were compared, not 1.5 sqrt(w))

strike.verdict: UNCLEAR (too few changes in the base)
strike.verdict_clean: UNCLEAR (too few changes in the base)

clean.planted: nothing (2.5 grid at spot 200, 5% of strikes and 2% of legs unlisted at random; BMO and AMC events)

fixedgrid.planted: nothing (no strike is ever listed or unlisted)

flat.planted: nothing (control: lowvol world with no smile)

flat_filt.planted: data: the OTM leg of the strike nearest F fails the filter on 25% of (session, expiry), no smile: switches that add almost nothing

fwd3.planted: params drift: forward from 3 strikes, params.yaml says 4

fwdcommon.planted: code: a forward error of 10 bp common to every expiry of a session

fwdrev.planted: code: forward from the 4 LARGEST |C - P|

fwdrev1.planted: code: forward from the 1 LARGEST |C - P|

lowvol.planted: nothing (control: vol 15%, 5 grid at spot 200 = 2.5%, no random unlisting)

lowvol_drop.planted: data: the 2 strikes nearest F unlisted on 50% of (session, expiry), lowvol world

lowvol_filt.planted: data: the OTM legs of the 2 strikes nearest F fail the quote filter on 50% of (session, expiry), lowvol world

mbump.planted: data: monthly expiries 1.5 vol points above the weeklies

minmid.planted: params drift: quote filter min mid 0.10, params.yaml says 0.05

sess_drop.planted: data: the 2 strikes nearest F unlisted on 12% of SESSIONS, every expiry at once

sess_filt.planted: data: the OTM legs of the 2 strikes nearest F fail the filter on 15% of SESSIONS, every expiry at once

spans0.planted: code: an expiry spans only from day 0 on (an AMC announcement-day expiry becomes clean)

tau1.planted: code: tau counts the snapshot session

ts_mild.planted: data: diffusive vol term structure (tau/21)^-0.25 (power note)

ts_slope.planted: data: diffusive vol term structure (tau/21)^-0.4, not flat

twoshort.planted: code: interpolate through the two shortest expiries

wrongpair.planted: code: interpolate takes the shortest expiry <= 21
